headline: Strong growth momentum sustains; new growth engines strengthen outlook

highlights: We note: (1) EBITDA margin expanded 63bps YoY, driven by richer premium mix and operating leverage, despite elevated commodity prices, and higher GTM investments.
(4) Management reiterated its FY27 targets of mid-teen revenue growth and early double-digit EBITDA margin.
We believe, strong execution, improving product mix and upcoming manufacturing capacity at Sri City position LG favourably to sustain growth ahead of the industry.
Growth was broad-based across categories, supported by volume expansion, premium product traction and healthy export momentum.
valuation: (4) Management reiterated its FY27 targets of mid-teen revenue growth and early double-digit EBITDA margin.
